request: User reports no sound at all on the physical iPhone after 0.2.65.
findings: Physical saved music/sound/voice toggles were all true. All 9 unchanged original WAVs contain nonzero PCM samples.

Old ambient/mix setup follows ring-silent behavior; its explicit mix option is outside the installed SDK category contract, although an actual simulator AVAudioPlayer baseline did play successfully. It is not proven to be the phone failure cause.
Two reproducible interruption defects: an ended interruption without shouldResume blocked all subsequent user effects indefinitely; toggling music could bypass a still-active interruption.
changes: Authorized Debug local listening uses playback plus mixWithOthers, controlled by in-game settings even when the ringer is silent. Other audio retains its route and can mix; formal ambient path uses no explicit mix option.

Separated active system interruption from waiting for user music resume. New sounds and haptics work after interruption ends; existing BGM stays paused until explicitly enabled if shouldResume was absent.

Added local Debug runtime snapshot of import/errors, effective switches, actual category, output volume/port type and player progress. No device or route names, user IDs, microphone recording or upload; writes only one Caches file off the input thread.

realPlayerResult.boundary: Actual AVAudioSession/AVAudioPlayer on simulator; not injected success and not proof of the phone speaker being audible.
